name: llvm-mos
description: Write, debug, and optimize C, C++, and assembly for 6502-family CPUs with the llvm-mos toolchain and SDK: inline-asm constraints and clobbers, the calling convention, linker scripts, banking, and cc65/ca65 migration. Also covers hacking on the toolchain itself: the MOS backend and MC layer, lld relocations, tablegen, and simulator-backed testing.

interface.shortDescription: C, C++, and assembly for 6502-family CPUs with the llvm-mos toolchain.
interface.longDescription: Reusable guidance for the llvm-mos LLVM backend and llvm-mos-sdk, covering the imaginary-register mental model, inline-assembly constraints and clobber discipline, the calling convention, linker scripts and OUTPUT_FORMAT, banking and zero-page allocation, Commodore and MEGA65 platform support, and migration from cc65/ca65. A second skill covers development of the toolchain itself: navigating the MOS subset of the LLVM monorepo, keeping an encoding convention consistent across the assembler, relaxation, linker and disassembler, MOS tablegen pitfalls, and the MC/lld/CodeGen/simulator test ladder.
defaultPrompt: Use llvm-mos to review this inline assembly block.
Use llvm-mos to write a linker script for this target.
Use llvm-mos-dev to add a relocation to the MOS backend and test it.
